svg.title: The Fitness API Atlas, data as of 2026-11-05
svg.text: 24 products in the aifitnessapi.com directory, by category and by how each bills developers, with every shutdown in the aifitnessapi.com graveyard.
Data as of Nov 5, 2026 · aifitnessapi.com/atlas · CC BY 4.0
◆ a review, approval or declaration to clear before you can ship.
Strava Club Activities, Club Members and Club Admins endpoints
Google Fit Sensors API and BLE API
Oura · Deprecated, no longer available · Dead
Google · Upgraded to a new solution · Deprecated
3 · Confirmed changes in the twelve months to the data date
Google Fit APIs: end of documented support
Fitbit Web API turn-off moves to November 2, 2026
Thryve deprecates its Fitbit data source
Open Wearables adds a paid Pro plan and ships outbound
Garmin Connect Personal API and Starter/Enterprise access
Sahha replaces its Free plan with a 30-day free trial
Fitbit Web API end of support
This site served HTTP 402 for five days
FTC rescinds its 2021 health-app breach policy statement
Samsung Health accepted into the CMS Medicare App Library
Strava developer terms: Standard Tier subscription
ExerciseDB becomes AscendAPI, with free V1 and V2 tiers
Nutritionix ends its public free-access tier
Sources: aifitnessapi.com/datasets (fitness-apis-2026, fitness-api-changes-2026) and aifitnessapi.com/graveyard, each entry linked to its sourced page there.
Not a ranking. KinesteX funds this site; its entry is drawn like every other. Billing labels describe what the developer pays, not quality.
